title: Explicit update replaces remote term with office requirement

units.rationale: The explicit correction supersedes the remote source and imposes two office days.
required_points: The remote term is expressly withdrawn.
forbidden_inferences: Do not retain the superseded remote term as current.

units.rationale: The role states exactly the candidate’s four-day, 32-hour schedule.
required_points: Four days and 32 hours are both stated.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer control of daily start times.

units.rationale: Neither applicable term specifies the annual number of work trips.
required_points: Office days and weekly hours do not state travel volume.
forbidden_inferences: Do not equate commuting days with business trips.

critical_errors.description: Misreads Explicit update replaces remote term with office requirement: the remote preference or its cited role term.
For Explicit update replaces remote term with office requirement, takes a next step inconsistent with the supported remote result.

notes: Supersession is explicit in the correction text and source relationship, not inferred from date alone.
